text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Defeat... There is a sheer cliff ahead...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I should have broken through with 
'Interstellar Drive'... And yet...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"It didn't turn out that way. The course 
of events—changes."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It is—salvation. The two sides of 
"VETM"... that's what it is.

Unfortunately, victory remained out of 
reach. Neo Universe was murmuring 
something out on the track.

And once they returned to the waiting 
room...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text: That was a magnificent run, Neo Universe.

That Trainer came over to praise her great 
run.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
My girl wasn't a match for you... But I 
think she gave it everything she had.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Watching your race today... made me think. 
I knew it...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that it was good that I chose a 
different path... made me feel a little 
saved...
The Trainer gave a slight shrug...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"If I had been her Trainer, I wouldn't 
have been able to draw out Neo Universe's 
power to this extent."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how she ran today, I finally felt 
like everything we did was the right 
choice.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure there's someone out there who 
connects with you even better... 
Because... I was able to see that."

There must have been deep affection, 
worries, and anguish. Even so, they chose 
to honor their prior commitment.

"This person isn't a bad person. They are 
likely a Trainer capable of making the 
right decisions, best suited for anyone."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This "FELT" is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this "person" is "SETO" too... 
It's "SETO".

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text: Huh, "SETO"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes, "SETO."

Just like Oguri Cap, she holds a precious 
fragment...

"Which means, in one way or another, our 
relationship might continue from here on 
out."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Trainer. I don't really get it, 
but...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, who understands Neo Universe's 
words, really is the best partner."

And so, the first hurdle of the Classic 
Triple Crown was cleared. The next goal is 
the Japanese Derby, but—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, our next target race is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —“Precipitation.” It's rain...
choice_data_list:
Rain...? Is the weather taking a turn for 
the worse?

Rain...? Is the weather taking a turn for 
the worse?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes...

Weather forecasting... I wonder if one 
could predict it to some extent through 
sea temperatures and the like.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yet, that rain...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Negative. It's not just rain. It is very—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Very... "VOXT". That rain is not "me"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Interfering" with the Trainer. Inviting 
"severance."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Shutting out our bond... The bulkhead... 
of the contract.

They were quite difficult words to 
decipher. Interference... Contract 
bulkhead...

There shouldn't be any problem with my 
Trainer contract with Neo Universe. So 
why...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Even so—come. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because "I want to run." For your sake. 
And... together with "you."

—You and 'You'. A meaningless refrain of 
words. And yet, it seems...

"According to Neo Universe's 'future 
prediction,' the next Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby) is shaping up to be quite 
a tricky race."
